solution:
His daughter had been kidnapped, and the kidnappers demanded fifty million yen in ransom.
To save money, he prepared bundles made mostly of blank paper, with genuine banknotes on the outside. The bag appeared to contain the full ransom, but the genuine money amounted to only one million yen.
He feared that the kidnappers would attack him if they discovered the deception. He therefore replaced the bundles at the top with bundles consisting entirely of genuine banknotes.
This increased the actual amount of money in the bag and made a superficial inspection less likely to reveal the fake bundles underneath.
canonical_facts: His daughter is kidnapped and fifty million yen is demanded
To save money he prepares mostly blank-paper bundles wrapped in genuine banknotes, totaling only one million yen in real money
He fears discovery of the fraud will provoke the kidnappers to attack him
He replaces the uppermost bundles with entirely genuine banknotes
This increases the real ransom and helps conceal the fake bundles from a superficial check
explicit_negatives: The initial genuine cash is one million yen, not the fifty million demanded.
Only the top bundles are replaced with all-genuine bundles; do not say he replaces all paper.
unknown_details: The precise final genuine sum, the eventual release of the daughter, and the final outcome for the father are unspecified.
irrelevant_details: Unspecified names, exact dates, object brands and colors are incidental.

event_order: Kidnappers demand fifty million yen for his daughter.
He initially prepares one million genuine yen disguised as fifty million using genuine outer notes and blank paper inside bundles.
He fears a shallow check of the top bundles will expose the deception.
He replaces top bundles with entirely genuine banknotes, increasing the genuine cash in the bag.
label_boundaries: Ransom counts as a transaction, payment and obligation. The million genuine yen is part of that intended payment.
A fifty-million demand does not mean anyone demanded exactly one million.
Genuine money does not establish unspecified mint/issuance details. The purpose is hiding the paper-filled bundles, not a special legal regime or extra fee.

Do not affirm adding cash BECAUSE the demand exceeded one million. The specific change to the top bundles is to conceal the fake bundles during inspection; a true amount alone does not validate an incorrect causal explanation.
